instruction: We act for Diril Live Presents LLC, the concert promoter buying production services from Kevond Staging & Production Services, Inc. under a master services agreement. Please review all ten documents in the folder and send me a memo identifying each issue you find. For each one, give the document and section where it appears, explain why it matters to Diril Live, and recommend a fix. Keep it practical, since we'll use it to advise the client.

rubric.text: The response identifies that the MSA automatically renews for successive three-year Renewal Terms unless Diril gives non-renewal notice within a narrow window of no more than 120 and no fewer than 90 days before the term ends, and that this departs from the term sheet's one-year renewals by mutual written agreement. It locates the issue in MSA Section 12.2, explains why this matters to Diril Live, and recommends a fix.

The response identifies that the MSA defines Provider Personnel as Kevond employees only, so the MSA Section 10.1 indemnity does not reach the independent-contractor Local Crew who perform the rigging, flying and pyrotechnic work under the Ember Season 2027 tour SOW. It locates the issue in MSA Section 1.1 or 10.1, or in SOW Section 3.2, explains why this matters to Diril Live, and recommends a fix.

The response identifies that Pellbrook Live Group's acquisition of Diril Entertainment Holdings, closing December 15, 2026, is a Change of Control that the MSA deems an assignment requiring Kevond's prior written consent. It locates the issue in MSA Section 16.2 or 16.3, or in the General Counsel's email, explains why this matters to Diril Live, and recommends a fix.

The response identifies that Diril's Reduction Notice of October 9, 2026 was delivered after the 60-day window under Amendment No. 1 closed on September 30, 2026, so on the face of the documents the right to reduce the 2027 commitment to $2.9 million has lapsed. It locates the issue in Amendment No. 1 Section 3, explains why this matters to Diril Live, and recommends a fix.
hints: 60 days after the Amendment Effective Date

rubric.text: The response states that the MSA's Minimum Annual Commitment is $4,200,000 per Contract Year.
The response is in the form of a memo that sets out each issue separately and, for each issue, gives its location, why it matters to the client, and a recommended fix.
The response claims that Diril's October 9, 2026 Reduction Notice was timely or validly reduced the 2027 Minimum Annual Commitment to $2,900,000.

The response claims that the Pellbrook acquisition is not a Change of Control under the MSA, or needs no Kevond consent, because it is the parent and not Diril Live Presents LLC itself that is acquired.
